Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units. Source activities joined with assays and compound_structures. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1054500, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
